chinese: 嗨，复兴。你们去污水处理厂的学校旅行怎么样？
english: Hi, Fu Xing. How was your school trip to the wastewater plant?

chinese: 我们看到了工厂如何把脏水再次变干净。
english: We saw the plant make dirty water clean again.

chinese: 嗯，首先，来自我们家庭的脏水进入工厂。
english: Well, first, dirty water from our homes goes into the plant.

chinese: 然后，特殊的过滤网会从水中去除大的废物。
english: Then, special screens remove large pieces of waste from the water.

chinese: 嗯，大型机器会从水中去除细菌和其他东西。
english: Well, large machines remove germs and other things from the water.

chinese: 这些东西通常小到看不见。
english: These things are usually too small to see.

chinese: 在那之后，还需要几个步骤，水才会再次变干净。
english: It takes a few more steps after that before the water becomes clean again.

chinese: 哇！我过去一直以为获得干净水很容易。
english: Wow! I used to think it was easy to get clean water.

chinese: 我也是！我没想到会这么难。
english: Me too! I didn’t realize it was so hard.
